=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:110-383 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new permanent script `scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh` has no entry in the Scripts roster of docs/INVENTORY.md.
  WHY: `python3 tests/inventory_parity.py` exits 1 with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh". That fails tests-release-and-log-analysis (check run 42897662333) before the new report-delivery tests can run, which keeps the required `lint` aggregate red. Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER. openai_gpt-6-luna anchored it at tests/inventory_parity.py lines 276-280.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py:test_sync_steps_read_the_run_branch_when_present | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts `'git pull --rebase origin "${TARGET_BRANCH}"' in block`. That string no longer appears anywhere in the workflow: the sync fallback at lines 1896–1899 and 2498–2501 only runs `git fetch ... --depth=1` plus `git checkout`, and the PR removed every `git pull --rebase`.
  WHY: The assertion will fail once the inventory_parity blocker is fixed and the test actually runs. The reviewer rated it BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:(check runs tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and orchestrate-poll (2) on head a46d55d99e13, run 42897662333) | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Two failing CI jobs feed the required `lint` aggregate, but neither failure maps to a hunk in this PR. The failing steps are beyond the captured log tails.
  WHY: `lint` stays red unless these failures are confirmed as inherited from the merge-base. The PR's own inherited-failure accounting already proved unreliable. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR, so the higher rating is used.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1673-1683 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification builds `REPORT_URL` from `REPORT_FILE` before deliver-report runs its collision check, and scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh (rename at lines 198-215, section 6) can rename the file on the run branch afterwards.
  WHY: After a collision rename, the link that was already sent returns 404. All reviewers rated it NIT. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite anchored it at scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh lines 219-247 and line 203.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2932-2934 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The deliver-report `if: ${{ always() && ... }}` condition also matches cancelled runs, so a GH_PAT-authored report PR is opened even after the workflow is cancelled.
  WHY: A cancelled run still triggers a full CI and AI review cycle. `!cancelled()` would keep the failed and skipped section paths, and the DELIVER_IF constant in tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py would need updating. The reviewer rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:section 5 (after `git worktree add`) through step 8 (`gh pr create`) | severity=low | confidence=n/a
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: deliver-report opens a GH_PAT-authored PR for whatever the run branch holds and never checks that only `analysis/workflow-optimization-YYYY-MM-DD(-N).md` paths changed.
  WHY: This is a hardening suggestion with no severity or confidence stated (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2 from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, 3 from minimax_minimax-m3). The suggested fix is a diff against `origin/${TARGET_BRANCH}...` plus `wla_deliver_fail unexpected_paths`, about 6-8 lines.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§23.E: authenticate the push only through a credential helper that reads the token from env. Never print the token."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml, the "Commit and push report", "Commit and push deep audit section" and "Commit and push API redundancy section" steps (pushes at 1619/2267/2868) and their checkouts (855-859, 1740-1744, 2350-2354)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The checkouts use `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` without `persist-credentials: false`, and `git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${REPORT_BRANCH}"` authenticates with the persisted .git/config credentials. Only the new deliver-report job (lines 2941-2944, GIT_CONFIG_* helper in scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh) follows §23.E. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 gave confidence 3 because Approach §1 does not explicitly require changing auth for these steps.
- requirement: "A final job opens one pull request into the default branch", with `gh pr create --base <default>`
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh, `TARGET_BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"` (~line 70) and `gh pr create --base "${TARGET_BRANCH}"` (~line 297)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The base comes from the dispatched ref, not the repository default branch, so a manual workflow_dispatch from a non-default branch opens the PR against that branch. The normal triggers (schedule, and test-and-mark-stable.yml dispatch at lines 4250-4261) land on the default branch. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` or `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef`.
- requirement: Every new script must be documented in `docs/INVENTORY.md`, enforced by `tests/inventory_parity.py`
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md, Scripts section roster (near line 382, `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh" and "FAIL: agents.md:2011: references scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it" (CI run 42897662333, failed[4]). agents.d/8963-log-analysis-report-pr-delivery.md names the script but no inventory entry was added. docs/INVENTORY.md is outside the plan's files_touched. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- requirement: Tests: `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` (the pre-push gate flagged it as "failures caused by this change: 1")
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml deliver-report checkout step (lines 2931-2935) OR tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR does not modify the failing test or its expected patterns. The new checkout with `persist-credentials: false` / `contents: read` is the most plausible cause, but the reviewer could not pinpoint the mismatch. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md:382-383 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Scripts roster has no bullet for `scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh`, although the workflow's `deliver-report` job runs it and the agents.d/8963-log-analysis-report-pr-delivery.md fragment names it.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` exits 1 (check run 42897662333). tests-release-and-log-analysis stops before the 21 new report-delivery cases run, `lint` stays red, and report PRs cannot merge. The pre-push gate wrongly called it "inherited". Fix: add one bullet between lines 382 and 383 (the file is outside files_touched, but CI requires it).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1676-1680 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Telegram link is sent before deliver-report's collision check, and section 6 of scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh can `git mv` the report.
  WHY: After a rename the link that was already sent returns 404.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (check runs tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and orchestrate-poll (2) on head a46d55d99e13) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Neither failure maps to a PR hunk. The failed[2] tail ends inside tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, and the failed[3] tail shows only PASS lines.
  WHY: Both feed the required `lint` aggregate. The editor should confirm on the merge-base rather than change code blindly.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2932-2934 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The deliver-report `always()` condition also matches cancelled runs, so a GH_PAT-authored report PR is opened after cancellation.
  WHY: `!cancelled() && ...` is enough for the issue's intent. The DELIVER_IF constant in tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py would need updating.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "§23.E: authenticate the push only through a credential helper that reads the token from env. Never print the token."
  Expected change site: The three run-branch push steps in .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (push at line 1619; checkouts at lines 856-859, 1741-1744, 2351-2354).
  Evidence of absence: The checkouts use `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` without `persist-credentials: false`, so the pushes authenticate with the persisted GH_PAT. Only deliver-report (lines 2941-2944, GIT_CONFIG_* helper) complies. The push output is redacted with sed, but the auth path is unchanged. Confidence is moderate because Approach §1 does not explicitly require it.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: "A final job opens one pull request into the default branch" (`pulls?state=open&base=<default>`, `gh pr create --base <default>`).
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh, `TARGET_BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"`.
  Evidence of absence: The base comes from the dispatched ref name, so a manual dispatch from a non-default branch targets that branch. The release gate dispatches on the default ref, and the old code also pushed to GITHUB_REF_NAME.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh section 5, after `git worktree add --detach "${worktree_dir}" "${run_ref}"`. Nothing checks that the run branch (also writable by the deep-audit and api-redundancy Codex jobs with persisted GH_PAT, checkout at line 1744) changes only analysis docs. Fix: `git diff --name-only "refs/remotes/origin/${TARGET_BRANCH}...${run_ref}"` and `wla_deliver_fail unexpected_paths` on any non-matching path. The depth-1 fetch may need raising. Estimated 6-8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
